comments:
413ba0cb:  .;
 .;This routine handles the third part of the variable width display
 .;for the DGJ IRT (Incomplete Records Tracking) module. It's designed
 .;to format and display detailed information for each record in a
 .;user-friendly, variable-width view.
8bc72f61: Check if the IRT record exists for the given patient and IRT entry; if not, quit.
bc6b2a3a: If there is a discharge type for the IRT record, get its value.
1b3d3f49: If there is no discharge type for the IRT record, initialize it with default values.
a72198c6: Retrieve the division from the hospital location and update DGJTDEL with its value, or keep DGJTDEL if not found.
5af61af7: Initialize variables for the header, set the patient name, and retrieve the patient ID.
9778e5a2: Set up variables for the record type and call function to get the latest record.
84197603: Clear the temporary global used for reports.
9d2ac668: Initialize list manager variables and counts.
38aa38c3: Format and display the header in the list.
58f3eb05: Reset the variable X to an empty string.
b3c4a1a6: Prepare the line number prefix for the first column.
d39046b0: Prepare the line number prefix for the second column and add to the list.
f069a233: Clear the string X for new data.
91a68279: Retrieve the type of deficiency from the IRT record.
916fffe3: Format the 'Type of Deficiency' label for display.
9c6fbea4: Add the type of deficiency to the display string.
4b058a4d: Set a flag for the specialty based on user permissions, the type of document, and view mode.
0104bc6d: Format the 'Specialty' label for display.
81389d02: Retrieve the specialty of the physician from the IRT record.
644ed307: Add the specialty to the display string and add this line to the list.
1ed1f9ff: Reset X to prepare for the next line of display.
cd061b2d: Prepare the 'Event Date' label, including an asterisk for editing mode.
8d06067e: Format the 'Event Date' label for display.
f921848a: Convert the event date from internal to external format.
e1816ea0: Add the formatted event date to the display string.
022ea6db: Prepare the 'Primary Physician' label, with conditions for displaying an asterisk.
ae203c06: Format the 'Primary Physician' label for display.
ab8c76c9: Retrieve the primary physician's name from the IRT record.
7ad1488c: Add the primary physician to the display string and add this line to the list.
d43265dd: Set up the 'Admission' label with an asterisk for editable fields.
1dc69a35: Format the 'Admission' label for display.
f96ffaee: Convert the admission date to external format if it exists.
113d0074: Set the default admission status to 'OUTPATIENT' if there is no admission date.
b096989a: Add the admission date or status to the display string.
d43322fe: Prepare the 'Attending Physician' label based on conditions including user permissions and view settings.
fb785c14: Format the 'Attending Physician' label for display if the conditions are met.
45ca6e5b: Retrieve the attending physician's name if the conditions are met.
78bae031: Add the attending physician to the display and finalize this section.
3704a040: Clear X to prepare for the next entry.
25ee2c77: Format the 'Division' label for display.
7268ed69: Retrieve the division name from the IRT record.
f298dc9f: Add the division name to the display string and finalize this line.
161d90df: Retrieve the location (clinic) name from the IRT record.
7ba6f1d3: Format the 'Location' label, including conditions for display.
9fa35738: Reset X for new data entry.
8e555a1e: Format the 'Location' label for display.
31f7a3e2: Retrieve the location name again for consistency.
61597f33: Add the location name to the display string.
4fe980ef: Retrieve the borrower's name from the RT data.
e86445f1: Format the 'Borrower' label for display.
dbb67513: Add the borrower's name to the display and finalize this line.
dfb19909: Retrieve the service from the IRT record.
458459f3: Get the service name for display.
9592191a: Clear X to prepare for the next line of display.
b9faa85a: Format the 'Service' label for display.
c022b9c7: Add the service name to the display string.
3e969413: Retrieve the phone/room number from the RT data.
cc2421c3: Format the 'Phone/Rm' label for display.
608cd6de: Add the phone/room number to the display and finalize this line.
3a56e0fd: Prepare X for the next line of data.
2ff4b651: Format the 'Phys. Responsible' label for display.
75fb7c81: Retrieve the responsible physician's name from the IRT record.
461a1e7d: Add the responsible physician to the display string.
e7a43645: Convert the charge date to external format if it exists.
752568b8: Format the 'Date Charged' label for display.
a875d323: Add the converted charge date to the display and finalize this line.
2014c837: Clear variables used in the process.
86d9e6ee: Call functions to display coded and by whom data.
90a736fe: Reset X for new data entry.
90adbc4a: Format and display the third item in the list.
4ab949da: Prepare X for the next section of the display.
857313c5: Format the 'Status' label for display.
a64cad54: Retrieve and display the status from the IRT record.
f07fb8ce: Add the status to the display and finalize this line.
f4b43b2b: If there are no comments, setup to display the 'Comments' section and proceed to display comments.
286af400: Call the function to display comments.
7d56c1ba: ;Set a display-only message if DGJTVIEW is not defined.
94f8d8be: ;Increment both the detail and summary line counters.
2ddd1d1b: ;Store the current line in the temporary global array and set its index.
a84ad932: ;Map the detail line counter to its corresponding summary line number.
cafe7d42: ;Exit the subroutine.
